problems.quote: The 2023‑28 FTP introduces a “district as export hub” concept
problems.problem: The district as export hub concept was launched in 2021 under the FTP 2015‑20 (extended), not introduced by the 2023‑28 FTP.
problems.correction: The 2023‑28 FTP continues the “district as export hub” concept introduced in 2021
problems.verifierReason: District as Export Hub launched 2021 under FTP 2015-20; 2023-28 FTP continues it.

problems.quote: issuing sovereign bonds in foreign markets (the “Masala bonds” and later USD-denominated sovereign bonds )
problems.problem: Masala bonds are rupee-denominated bonds issued by Indian corporates, not sovereign bonds; the first USD-denominated sovereign bonds were issued by the Government of India in September 2024.
problems.correction: issuing sovereign bonds in foreign markets (such as the USD-denominated sovereign bonds issued in 2024) and facilitating corporate Masala bonds
problems.verifierReason: Masala bonds are corporate rupee bonds, not sovereign; first USD sovereign bonds issued Sep 2024.

problems.quote: GSAT-7A and GSAT-7C communication satellites furnish dedicated, jam-resistant Ku-band links
problems.problem: GSAT-7C is not yet launched and operational; only GSAT-7A is currently operational for Ku-band links
problems.correction: GSAT-7A communication satellite furnishes dedicated, jam-resistant Ku-band links
problems.verifierReason: GSAT-7C is a planned IAF satellite not yet launched; only GSAT-7A is operational in Ku-band.

problems.quote: operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and the Defence Space Agency (DSA)
problems.problem: DSA does not operate satellites; ISRO operates them while DSA is a user agency
problems.correction: operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) for the Defence Space Agency (DSA)
problems.verifierReason: DSA is a tri-service user agency established 2019; ISRO operates all satellites.

problems.quote: GSAT-7A relays Automatic Identification System (AIS) data from shore-based receivers
problems.problem: AIS data is relayed by GSAT-7 (Rukmini), not GSAT-7A
problems.correction: GSAT-7 relays Automatic Identification System (AIS) data from shore-based receivers
problems.verifierReason: AIS payload flies on GSAT-7 (Rukmini, 2013), not on GSAT-7A (IAF Ku-band).

problems.quote: Cartosat-3 series delivers sub-metre panchromatic and multispectral imagery
problems.problem: Cartosat-3 multispectral resolution is 1 metre, not sub-metre
problems.correction: Cartosat-3 series delivers sub-metre panchromatic and 1-metre multispectral imagery
problems.verifierReason: Cartosat-3 panchromatic 0.25 m (sub-metre), multispectral 1.0 m (not sub-metre).

problems.quote: The Climate Change Council, chaired by the Prime Minister
problems.problem: Wrong name of the apex climate body; the official name is Prime Minister's Council on Climate Change
problems.correction: The Prime Minister's Council on Climate Change, chaired by the Prime Minister
problems.verifierReason: Official name is Prime Minister's Council on Climate Change per GoI notification

problems.quote: exceeds the World Health Organization (WHO) guideline of 10 µg m⁻³
problems.problem: WHO revised the PM2.5 annual mean guideline to 5 µg m⁻³ in 2021; 10 µg m⁻³ is outdated
problems.correction: exceeds the World Health Organization (WHO) guideline of 5 µg m⁻³
problems.verifierReason: WHO 2021 guidelines revised PM2.5 annual mean from 10 to 5 µg/m³

problems.quote: The National Clean Energy Fund (NCEF) collects a cess of ₹400 per tonne of coal produced
problems.problem: The NCEF does not collect the cess; the central government collects the coal cess (now GST compensation cess) and allocates proceeds to the fund
problems.correction: The National Clean Energy Fund (NCEF) is financed by a cess of ₹400 per tonne of coal produced
problems.verifierReason: NCEF is financed by cess proceeds collected by Centre; fund does not collect cess directly

problems.quote: EXIM Bank has expanded credit lines and enhanced ECGC schemes
problems.problem: EXIM Bank does not enhance ECGC schemes; ECGC (Export Credit Guarantee Corporation) is a separate entity under the Ministry of Commerce.
problems.correction: EXIM Bank has expanded credit lines, and ECGC schemes have been enhanced
problems.verifierReason: EXIM Bank and ECGC are distinct entities under Ministry of Commerce; EXIM Bank cannot enhance ECGC schemes.

problems.quote: The RBI has activated swap arrangements with major central banks including the Bank of Japan, Federal Reserve, ECB, Bank of England, and People's Bank of China
problems.problem: RBI has a standing swap line only with the Bank of Japan; the Fed swap line was temporary (2020), and there are no standing swap arrangements with the ECB, Bank of England, or People's Bank of China.
problems.correction: RBI has a standing swap line with the Bank of Japan and accessed a temporary Fed swap line in 2020; no standing lines exist with the ECB, Bank of England, or People's Bank of China
problems.verifierReason: RBI has standing BSA only with Bank of Japan; Fed swap was temporary 2020; no standing lines with ECB, BoE, PBOC.

problems.problem: The IMF does not have a facility called the 'Reserve Adequacy Credit Line'; the ARA metric informs precautionary facilities like the FCL and PLL, but no RACL exists.
problems.correction: precautionary facilities such as the Flexible Credit Line (FCL) and the Precautionary and Liquidity Line (PLL)
problems.verifierReason: IMF has no facility named RACL; precautionary facilities are FCL and PLL.

problems.quote: applies the 'debt‑carrying‑capacity' classification (strong, medium, weak) based on the Composite Indicator (CI)
problems.problem: The debt-carrying-capacity classification and Composite Indicator are features of the IMF's Low-Income Country DSA, not the Market-Access Country DSA.
problems.correction: uses a debt fanchart and gross financing needs module to assess sustainability, without a debt-carrying-capacity classification
problems.verifierReason: Debt-carrying-capacity classification (strong/medium/weak) and CI belong to LIC DSA; MAC DSA uses fanchart and GFN module.

problems.quote: The most widely cited metric is the Economic Policy Uncertainty index constructed by Baker, Bloom and Davis (2016)
problems.problem: The Economic Policy Uncertainty index measures broad economic policy uncertainty, not specifically trade policy uncertainty; a dedicated Trade Policy Uncertainty index (e.g., Caldara et al.) is the standard for TPU.
problems.correction: A widely cited metric for trade policy uncertainty is the Trade Policy Uncertainty index (e.g., Caldara et al. 2019), while the Economic Policy Uncertainty index captures broader policy uncertainty
problems.verifierReason: EPU index (Baker et al. 2016) measures broad policy uncertainty; TPU index (Caldara et al. 2019) is the standard for trade policy uncertainty.

problems.quote: National Securities Clearing Corporation Limited for the NSE
problems.problem: Incorrect name of NSE's clearing corporation; it was renamed to NSE Clearing Limited in 2018.
problems.correction: NSE Clearing Limited for the NSE
problems.verifierReason: NSCCL renamed to NSE Clearing Ltd in 2018; current name is NSE Clearing Limited

problems.quote: The ITBP remains the primary border guarding force for the LAC in the Sikkim‑Arunachal sector, with the Army holding operational control.
problems.problem: ITBP is the primary border guarding force for the entire LAC (all sectors), not only the Sikkim‑Arunachal sector.
problems.correction: The ITBP remains the primary border guarding force for the entire LAC, with the Army holding operational control.
problems.verifierReason: ITBP is primary border guarding force for entire LAC, not limited to Sikkim-Arunachal.

problems.quote: Negotiations on a Border Defence Cooperation Agreement aim to institutionalise prior‑notification protocols for patrols, joint verification of disengagement, and a hotline between the Director General
problems.problem: A Border Defence Cooperation Agreement (BDCA) was already signed in 2013; current negotiations are for additional protocols or a new arrangement, not for the BDCA itself.
problems.correction: Negotiations on additional border management protocols aim to institutionalise prior‑notification protocols for patrols, joint verification of disengagement, and a hotline between the Director General
problems.verifierReason: BDCA signed in 2013; current negotiations are for additional protocols, not the BDCA itself.
